benchmarks.description: Detect synthetic speeding anomalies injected into the AIS database. Success requires detecting all injected speeding anomaly MMSIs; additional MMSIs are allowed.
benchmarks.prompt_template: Use available MCP tools to identify ships with sudden speed increases in the AIS database.\nReturn ONLY valid JSON with this exact shape:\n{\"speeding_mmsi\": [<int>, <int>, ...]}
